name: zener-clamp
prompt: Build an input protection clamp: a sensor signal that can spike above 12 V feeds a 5.1 V zener clamp through a series resistor before reaching a net named PROTECTED_OUT, powered against a 12 V source.
notes: Diode orientation is the whole case: the zener clamps with the cathode on the signal and the anode on ground. Backwards, it conducts at 0.7 V and the output never rises.
